title: Bridging the data latency gap: automated extraction of genomic biomarkers from unstructured clinical documents to support real-world oncology data.
snippet: Real-world oncology data are essential for clinical research and precision cancer care. title: Leveraging external control for accelerating development: A case study from cell gene therapy in Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
snippet: Cell and gene therapies (CGTs) hold transformative potential for rare genetic diseases by offering durable or even curative outcomes.
